clips.title: The story
paras: At Stonetalon Peak, kaldorei Sentinels and druids keep watch over an ancient sanctuary. The sheltered valley is sacred to the night elves and remains the Alliance’s main foothold in the high mountains.

Stonetalon Peak opens into a green valley high above the dry lower ranges. Its ruins reach back millennia, to temples that honored Queen Azshara before the Great Sundering. Night elven Sentinels and druids now care for the sanctuary. They keep a barrow den and an Alliance flight roost here.

During the Third War, Jaina Proudmoore’s human expedition and Thrall’s Horde climbed Stonetalon Peak, each seeking the Oracle in the mountain’s deep caverns. Medivh’s visions had guided them there. Their encounter brought mortal enemies together, and they set aside their blades. That uneasy pact helped them stand against the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal. Sentinel patrols still guard the peak, while Horde incursions in the lowlands keep its defenders alert.
